chapter: Three Deuces and 52nd Street with Tatum
title: Amplifier trouble at the Apollo
summary: His biggest equipment problem was a pulled plug when a stage wire got caught at the Apollo.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: Did you ever have trouble with your equipment or amplifier?

No, my biggest problem was the plug being pulled out. I know I was at the Apollo Theater playing and the stage moves back and forth, you know they got it on rollers. Somehow my wire got under there and pulled the whole thing apart, oh boy. I had to play that whole performance with no nothin'. But I was there. People know. But the stagehands, they made a mistake. I don't think it was on purpose...
